History, Not Teratology
To dismantle the Black Legend is not to construct a
hagiography of a flawless leader. It is to refuse the
intellectual surrender of "teratology"-the study of
monsters.
The atrocities and achievements of the Soviet Union from
1924 to 1953 were not the products of a unique,
inexplicable madness. They were the tragic, contradictory
outcomes of human beings navigating the most brutal
geopolitical crucible of the 20th century.
True history demands context, comparison, and the
courage to look past the myths we inherited.
